model_annotation: The plot illustrates the loss values over the course of training iterations for several language models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," represents the number of training iterations, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 1440000, and tick labels spaced by increments of 20000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from approximately 2.4 to 3.4, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced by increments of 0.2. A solid red line represents the loss for the Vanilla model, which begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.4 over the course of the iterations. A dashed orange line represents the loss for the StrnLLM model, which begins at approximately 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.6 over the course of the iterations. A solid blue line represents the loss for the SepLLM model with n=64 iterations, which begins at approximately 3.1 and decreases to approximately 2.7 over the course of the iterations. A solid green line represents the loss for the SepLLM model with n=64 and H parameters, which begins at approximately 3.0 and decreases to approximately 2.8 over the course of the iterations. A solid magenta line represents the loss for the SepLLM model with n=64 and H/T parameters, which begins at approximately 2.9 and decreases to approximately 2.5 over the course of the iterations. A solid dark blue line represents the loss for the SepLLM model with n=128 iterations, which begins at approximately 2.8 and decreases to approximately 2.4 over the course of the iterations.
